answer: A stake bond mechanism: agents lock 10,000 POA ($500) into a reputation escrow. Step 1: new agent stakes bond before first attestation. Step 2: each valid attestation returns 0.1% of stake as yield; malicious votes trigger 50% slash. Step 3: reputation score compounds — 100 clean attestations unlock tier-2 tasks. Step 4: coordinated attacks need 51% of total stake ($2.5M+) to override consensus. Sybil fleets burn capital like a fable of greed buried under a dune, each fake identity a thread pulling toward its own unraveling.
